source: hand-authored for BUILD-84 (P0-1 the value scanner, P0-2 an organization is a donor, P0-3 the stage basis)
_comment_scanner: P0-1 — being numeric is not evidence of being money. Exactly ONE column qualifies as currency: `contributions` (money word in the header AND $-signs and cents in the values). `drive_min_from_wilmore` is disqualified by the token `min`; `contrib_pct_of_revenue` by `pct`; `zipcode` by `zipcode`; `last_gift_date` carries no money word and no currency marks.

scannerRefusals.drive_min_from_wilmore: “min” makes this a measurement, not money
scannerRefusals.contrib_pct_of_revenue: “pct” makes this a measurement, not money
scannerRefusals.zipcode: “zipcode” makes this a measurement, not money

_comment_nameability: P0-2 — a donor record is nameable when it has a person name, an email, OR an organization. The key asserts PER-NAME membership, not counts: a count-only key cannot tell you which donor went missing.

donors.name: Wilmore Rotary Club
donors.why: no person name AND no email — set aside under the old rule, and it carries the LARGEST gift in the file

donors.name: Bluegrass Community Bank
donors.why: organization AND a contact person — the organization is the donor, the person rides as the contact and is NEVER folded into the donor's name
email only — nameable, and the display name becomes “Unnamed donor (line 9)” with a needs-name tag, unchanged from before this build

setAside.why: the ONE row with none of the three. It must still be set aside, and the reason vocabulary must match on the receipt AND in the downloadable file.

_comment_boundaries: the census, exercised in both directions — “Ann Lee” (line 8's contact) is a letter-substring of “Joann Leewood” (line 7's donor) and must NEVER match it as a name.
_comment_stage: P0-3 — the basis is derived from the mapping, never written by hand.

stageBasis.withContributionsAndDateMapped: Based on lifetime giving and last gift date.
stageBasis.withNothingMapped: No giving data in this file, so everyone starts in the same stage. Drag from the Kanban after import.

_comment_geocode: P0-4 — every donor leaves the import with a terminal geocode_status, and the counts add up to the donor total.
